texts.preamble: Deep Shankar vs The State Of Bihar & Ors on 19 July, 2016 Author: Kishore Kumar Mandal Bench: Kishore Kumar Mandal In The High Court Of Judicature At Patna Civil Writ Jurisdiction Case No.24948 of 2013 ====================================================== 1. Deep Shankar Son Of Late Lalit Kumar Prasad Resident Of Mohalla Bara Bazar, P.S. Madhubani Town, District Madhubani (Proprietor Of Amrapali Sweets, Bara Bazar, Madhubani) .... .... Petitioner Versus 1. The State Of Bihar through The Food Safety Commissioner, Govt. Of Bihar, Patna 2. Food Safety Officer, Darbhanga Division, Office of Civil Surgeon Darbhanga At Laheria Sarai, District Darbhanga 3. The Additional Collector, Madhubani .... .... Respondent/s ====================================================== Appearance : For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Dr. Mayanand Jha For the Respondent/s : None ====================================================== Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Kishore Kumar Mandal Oral Order 2 19-07-2016
texts.facts: For adulterating the sweets he was proceeded against under the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 ( for short 'the Act'). The report of the analysis at the laboratory was furnished to the petitioner. In para- 18 it is stated that Food Safety Appellate Tribunal is not functioning . Mr. Jha has fairly stated that the Tribunal constituted under Section 76 of the Act is now functioning. Any appeal could have been filed before the appellate authority /Tribunal within 45 days. Seen thus, the petitioner has statutory remedy available to assail the order where all questions of fact and law can be agitated.
